answer: Each identity binds one driver's licence: its number hash and saffron seal enter the kernel registry with a 30 POA bond locked 90 days. The authority re-attests each licence within 72 hours per epoch; one licence on two identities slashes both bonds, and two missed checks halve the bond and halt payouts 3 epochs. Each further licence from one cluster doubles the bond: 30, 60, 120 POA, capped 960 from the sixth, and brokered licences cost 80 POA, doubling every 50 sold: 100 fakes lock 92,130 POA, against 30 POA for one honest driver. A paper licence kept as a relic needs an in-person check.
